title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 EDNS(0) and DNS Message Size Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, boundary-value tests, and fuzz-style property tests on DoqMessageCodec for message-size enforcement and EDNS(0) UDP payload size field ignoring.
scope: This verification covers the codec's message-size admission logic, including boundary values at 65534, 65535, and 65536 bytes, and malformed/overflowing length prefixes. It does not cover DNS padding or stream-level behavior.
preconditions: The DoQ foundation slice (0001) exists and passes.
DoqMessageCodec is stable and unit-testable without QUIC transport.
expected_result: The focused DoQ foundation tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts including slice 0009, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The DoqMessageCodec now explicitly enforces the 65535-byte maximum message size and ignores the EDNS(0) UDP payload size field. Both REQ-0084 and REQ-0085 are traced and verified with boundary and fuzz tests.
